---
title: "Work plan"
description: "Work packages, milestones and experiments."
---

The project is organised in six work packages. The first five end at a milestone that decides how the work continues.

## Work packages

| Package | What it does | Milestone | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **WP0** State of the art | Systematic review in Scopus, IEEE Xplore and Web of Science; what the safety standards require of analog diagnostic coverage | G0: the gap exists | [In progress]{.tag .in-progress} |
| **WP1** Benchmark and certification | Coverage metrics of the standards with intervals, adaptive Monte Carlo and reimplemented reference methods; definition of the demonstrator | G1: the reimplemented methods reproduce the published figures | [Pending]{.tag} |
| **WP2** Formulation and algorithms | Minimum hardware cost to reach a coverage target: cost model, risk weighting, selection algorithms and theoretical bound | G2: the greedy algorithm stays close to the optimum and risk changes the selection | [Pending]{.tag} |
| **WP3** Board validation | Simple boards with typical analog blocks, fault injection and self-test firmware | G3: the simulated ranking holds on the board | [Pending]{.tag} |
| **WP4** Safety demonstrator and applications | Battery management system taken to a mock safety assessment against a table-based FMEDA; ECG front end and bridge sensor conditioning as secondary cases | G4: the computed coverage meets the safety target with less diagnostic hardware | [Pending]{.tag} |
| **WP5** Tool and exploitation | Export to FMEDA, web GUI, documentation and training for industry, dataset and teaching material | — | [Pending]{.tag} |

: {tbl-colwidths="[24,34,28,14]"}

The tasks of each package and their estimated duration are in the [ROADMAP](https://github.com/telmomm/CERTA/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) of the repository.

## Experiments

| Id | Question |
| --- | --- |
| E1 | Do the reimplemented methods reproduce the published figures? |
| E2 | How far is the greedy algorithm from the exact optimum? |
| E3 | What does optimising node, stimulus and measurement at once add? |
| E4 | Does the solution change when weighting by risk? |
| E5 | How many Monte Carlo runs are needed for the rankings to be stable? |
| E6 | Do the tests chosen in simulation hold in hardware? |
| E7 | What does computing the diagnostic coverage change with respect to crediting it from tables? |

: {tbl-colwidths="[10,90]"}
